\"><h2>RelicDex — PRU 450 source edition</h2><p><b>450 playable Dex numbers</b>, <b>${mons.filter(m=>m.battleSprite).length} current source front-art links</b>, <b>${mons.reduce((a,m)=>a+m.moves.length,0).toLocaleString()} extracted level-up moves</b> and ${trainers.length} archival trainer portraits.</p><p>Effective 31 October 2026. This is based on successful GitHub PRU clean-build source <code>c0d98e67df00e1b1340c7b4fb3f851e922bf328a</code> and the latest approved PRU Notion canon; PKR/PHR/PJR/PRL project builds are retired reference sources.</p><p>All <b>450 Pokémon entries now include embedded illustrations</b>. The final 12 front sprites were sourced from the PRU GitHub repository, including the current Seviian Rock/Ghost forms and Valkiri under its former internal asset name, Valkyvoir. Those 12 load locally without internet; the prior 438 retain their existing remote-priority behaviour and archival fallbacks. Other sprite artwork still requires a separate in-game visual approval audit.</p><p>The 450-entry list and level-up move records are source-derived, not proof that every form, evolution or trainer sprite has been user-tested in the ROM. Evolution methods and locations still require separate in-game QA. Newly added species with zero statistics require a species-info source audit.</p><p><a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1btIGLXVmJmUNLjeU-01-AEj8gYMnrjDxtAnSGQ23P0U/edit">Open updated PRU Pokédex and movesets ↗</a></p><p><a href="https://github.com/jamesthoward2112-tech/Pokemon-Relics-Ultimate/actions/runs/42097722473">Source-validated successful run ↗</a></p>`;
 }
}

function unownSelectionHTML(f){
 const rows=f.moves.map(move=>`<div class="move"><b>Lv ${move.level}</b><span>${esc(move.name)}</span></div>`).join('');
 const statLabels=[['hp','HP'],['atk','ATK'],['def','DEF'],['spa','SPA'],['spd','SPD'],['spe','SPE']];
 return `<div class="unown-focus"><img class="unown-focus-portrait" src="${esc(f.image)}" alt="${esc(f.name)} front sprite"/><div><h4 class="unown-focus-title">${esc(f.name)}</h4><div class="unown-focus-meta">${esc(f.role)}<br/><b>Type:</b> Psychic<br/><b>Ability:</b> ${esc(f.ability)}<br/>${statLabels.map(([k,label])=>`${label} ${f.stats[k]}`).join(' · ')}</div></div></div><p class="unown-form-note">${esc(f.note)}</p><div class="moves-head"><h3>${esc(f.name)} moves <span class="muted">(${f.moves.length})</span></h3></div><div class="unown-form-moves">${rows}</div>`;
}
function openUnownDetails(m){
 openId=m.id;
 const forms=DATA.unownForms;
 const allButtons=forms.map(f=>`<button type="button" class="unown-form-btn ${f.key==='eye'?'active':''}" data-unown-key="${esc(f.key)}" aria-label="View ${esc(f.name)} art and moves"><img loading="lazy" alt="" src="${esc(f.image)}"/><span class="form-label">${esc(f.label)}</span></button>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('detailContent').innerHTML=`<div class="detailheader"><div class="detailhero">${img(m,m.name)}</div><div class="details-title"><small>PRU #245 · one Pokédex number</small><h2>Unown</h2>${chip('Psychic')}</div></div><h3>Eye Unown · Special Relic form</h3><p class="unown-gallery-desc">Eye Unown shares #245 with ordinary Unown, but has unique stats, ability and moves. Its normal I artwork is shown for completeness; the playable I species slot is the special Eye form.</p><section id="unownInspect" aria-live="polite">${unownSelectionHTML(forms[0])}</section><h3>Browse all 29 Unown artworks</h3><p class="unown-gallery-desc">Tap any letter, <b>!</b>, <b>?</b> or the Eye Relic to change the displayed sprite, stats, ability and level-up moves.</p><div class="unown-form-grid" role="group" aria-label="Select Unown form">${allButtons}</div><p class="notes">Source: current PRU Job 15 species and learnset tables. All 29 images are embedded and work offline. Eye Relic shares Pokédex #245 with Unown.</p>`;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-unown-key]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
   const next=forms.find(f=>f.key===btn.dataset.unownKey);
   if(!next)return;
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-unown-key]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn));
   const panel=document.getElementById('unownInspect');panel.innerHTML=unownSelectionHTML(next);
   panel.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});
 }));
 showDialog();
}

function openDetail(m){if(m.id===245){openUnownDetails(m);return;}openId=m.id;const names=['HP','ATK','DEF','SPA','SPD','SPE'],stats=['hp','atk','def','spa','spd','spe'];
 const pieces=[`<div class="detailheader"><div class="detailhero">${img(m,m.name)}</div><div class="details-title"><small>PRU #${String(m.id).padStart(3,'0')} · BST ${m.bst}</small><h2>${esc(m.name)}</h2><div class="typebar" style="justify-content:flex-start">${m.types.map(chip).join('')}</div></div></div>`,
 `<h3>Base stats</h3><div class="stats">${stats.map((k,i)=>`<div class="stat"><b>${names[i]}</b><span class="stat-num">${m[k]}</span><div class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.min(m[k]/180*100,100)}%"></i></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`,
 `<h3>Species details</h3><div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Abilities</small>${esc(m.abilities||'—')}</div><div class="fact"><small>Evolution</small>${esc(m.evolution||'—')}</div><div class="fact"><small>Region/source</small>${esc(m.region||m.source||'—')}</div><div class="fact"><small>Area/location</small>${esc(m.area||'Not yet specified')}</div></div>`,
 `<div class="moves-head"><h3>Level-up moves <span class="muted">(${m.moves.length})</span></h3><button id="showMoves">Show moves</button></div><div id="movelist" class="moves">${m.moves.map(move=>`<div class="move"><b>Lv ${move.level}</b><span>${esc(move.name)}</span></div>`).join('')||'<p>Moveset not yet source-verified.</p>'}</div>`,
 `<p class="notes">${m.notes?esc(m.notes)+' · ':''}Artwork: exact ${esc(m.frontVersion||"PRU")} · ${esc(m.finalFrontSpriteFilename||"front")}, embedded for offline viewing · ROM QA: ${esc(m.qa||'pending')}</p>`];
 document.getElementById('detailContent').innerHTML=pieces.join('');
 const b=document.getElementById('showMoves');b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const list=document.getElementById('movelist');const expanded=list.classList.toggle('expanded');b.textContent=expanded?'Hide moves':'Show moves'});
 showDialog();
}
function openTrainer(t){document.getElementById('detailContent').innerHTML=`<div class="detailheader"><div class="detailhero">${img(t,t.name)}</div><div class="details-title"><small>Trainer portrait · ${esc(t.region)}</small><h2>${esc(t.name)}</h2></div></div><h3>Portrait information</h3><div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Role</small>${esc(t.role||'—')}</div><div class="fact"><small>Chosen artwork</small>${esc(t.choice||'—')}</div></div><p class="notes">${esc(t.status||'PRU integration pending')}. Embedded for inspection; no implied final battle-art approval.</p>`;showDialog()}
function showDialog(){document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.add('open');document.getElementById('detail').classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}
function closeDialog(){document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.remove('open');document.getElementById('detail').classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow='';openId=null}
document.getElementById('search').addEventListener('input',e=>{query=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();render()});document.getElementById('type').addEventListener('change',e=>{type=e.target.value;render()});document.getElementById('sort').addEventListener('change',e=>{sort=e.target.value;render()});
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{tab=b.dataset.tab;closeDialog();render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})}));
grid.addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('[data-id],[data-trainer]');if(!btn)return;if(btn.dataset.id)openDetail(mons.find(x=>x.id===Number(btn.dataset.id)));else openTrainer(trainers[Number(btn.dataset.trainer)])});
document.getElementById('close').addEventListener('click',closeDialog);document.getElementById('backdrop').addEventListener('click',closeDialog);document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeDialog()});
render();
</script></body></html>
